column1: # ARC 3 / R13 -- THE ADJUDICATED CEILINGS OF THE EXTERNAL-TRUTH FLOW
# One row per (leg, isa).  A leg's HEADLINE is the count of rows where the
# tracer drops information a reference states, or where the difference is not
# understood.  The CEILING is the value a maintainer has adjudicated, row by
# row, in the verdict named in ADJUDICATION.  The gate FAILS when a headline
# EXCEEDS its ceiling, when a report is missing, when a headline cannot be
# parsed, or when the leg's scored population is below FLOOR.
# A ceiling is never a target.  RETIRED_BY names the work item whose landing
# must lower it; a ceiling with no RETIRED_BY is one this project accepts as
# a property of the reference, not of the trace.

RE-POINTED AT THE OFFLINE REFEREE.  THE x86_64 STATIC-DECODE LEG drove build/contrib/plugins/isaxcheck, a binary that linked Capstone into the build and was deleted with it, so this row had NO PRODUCER at the tip and read REPORT MISSING -- a red about the apparatus and not about the trace.  Per the standing external-comparison ruling the reference now runs OFFLINE over recorded encodings, and the row is re-pointed at the successor rather than retired: cst_referee.py decodes the recorded encodings offline and gapreport.py joins its opcode word against QEMU's, one bucket per encoding, with every disagreement class arbitrated in gapreport_rulings.tsv.  WHAT THE OLD ROW MEASURED: a reachable-decode-row population probed against LLVM MC, headline TRACER-SUBSET + UNACCOUNTED + HOLE, ceiling 11 over 3,123 probed rows at exec179.  WHAT THIS ONE MEASURES: the same question -- does the trace drop what a reference states, and is every difference understood -- over the encodings the guest actually ran.  The headline is UNRULED encodings (the difference nobody has read) PLUS COVERAGE-PATH encodings (read, and the reference won: the wire owes a change).  Arbitrated-to-QEMU encodings are outside it, exactly as TRACER-SUPERSET was.  CEILING 3, DERIVED FROM THIS READING AND NOT SET TO IT: UNRULED is 0 and the 3 are the coverage-path encodings, each with a written per-row arbitration -- `fild m32int` (the reference's FP_CVT keeps the conversion the wire's LOAD drops), `ud2` (the reference names the trap this encoding IS, the wire names nothing), and `xgetbv` (the reference's NOP is false and the verdict went to QEMU, but the 0F 01 group still owes a word one level down).  NO MARGIN: a headline of 4 is a finding to open.  FLOOR 95000 against 105,762 encodings joined with the reference at this tip.  THE STALE FIXTURE IS GONE WITH THE ROW: the selftest default carried 47 against a ceiling of 11 because the banked root predates exec179's re-derivation; the successor report is regenerated at the tip as part of this re-point and the fixture moves with it per #305. exec247 RE-DERIVATION (2026-09-18, all eleven legs re-run at one settled tip; the table scored twice, byte-identical).  HEADLINE 49 -> 33 = 20 TRACER-SUBSET + 13 UNACCOUNTED over 1,003 facts / 210 distinct encodings, no axis INERT.  CEILING HELD AT 22 AND THE ROW IS STILL RED.  THE SIXTEEN THAT MOVED ARE ONE CLASS AND ONE COMMIT: 48653af97d put the FPSR on the wire.  Every aarch64 floating-point and vector instruction reads the FPSR's rounding mode and writes its cumulative exception bits, and before that commit the wire named it on neither side; the reference named it on both, so each such instruction was a TRACER-SUBSET row.  Corroborated on the axis table rather than inferred: fpsr-dst-set disagreements 3 of 255 where exec246 read more, and the category table's vocabulary-difference TRACER-SUBSET column 24 -> 12 with reference-defect (5) and emulation-artefact (3) unmoved -- the classes that were NOT the FPSR did not move at all.  THE TWENTY THAT SURVIVE ALL CARRY A RULE: 5 reference-defect, 12 vocabulary-difference, 3 emulation-artefact.  THE THIRTEEN UNACCOUNTED ARE ENUMERATED, AND THEY ARE NOT ALL ONE THING -- exec246 recorded them as '12 memop rows plus 1 ORTHOGONAL', which is right on the count and wrong on the direction, and the correction is measured from rows.tsv: (1) NINE rows, three axes each on `dc cvau, x21' 0x4000bc, `dc civac, x21' 0x4000c0 and `dc cvac, x21' 0x4000c4 -- ref (0L/1S) of 64 bytes against trc (0L/0S) and no address.  TRACER-SUBSET, a REAL LOSS, and 14c81f0eca is the commit that decided it is one: format.rst 5.2 already puts cache-line clean/flush/invalidate in the synthesised-EA class with the address in LOAD_ADDR[0], so the wire owes this access and ruling it a reference limit would contradict the project's own spec.  That commit states the decision, banks the refutation of the PL0_W candidate over all 51 crn==7 ARM_CP_NOP cpregs, and deliberately moves no row; what closes it is an ARM_CP_* type bit on the by-VA cpregs plus the CTR_EL0 line size, a wave of its own.  (2) THREE rows on `dc zva, x21' 0x4000cc, and these are TRACER-SUPERSET, not subset: ref (0L/1S) 64 bytes against trc (0L/32S) 512 bytes.  DC ZVA genuinely zeroes a block, the wire publishes it, and the disagreement is the block SIZE and the SPLIT -- gem5 issues one line-sized access where the wire publishes the per-element stores.  It is unaccounted because no rule names that shape, not because anything is missing.  (3) ONE row, reg-dst-set on `msr ic_ivau_xt, x21' 0x4000c8, ORTHOGONAL: ref {MISC:ic_ivau_xt} against trc {REG_PC}.  NO CEILING MOVEMENT IS EARNED OR TAKEN: 22 counts rows this project accepts, and (1) is a real loss with a written fix path while (2) and (3) are unread shapes -- raising 22 to meet a measurement is the pattern this project refuses.  Prior adjudication, unchanged where it was not superseded: the exec246 text (51 -> 49, the 244-C de-interleaving repair and the REF-NEON-PAIRWISE-DEST parity predicate) and R13_VERDICT.md 4.1

exec245 RE-MEASUREMENT (2026-09-18, four arms on ONE build: BASE, after the FR=0 preserve-read fix, after the condition-code write statement, and at the final tree).  HEADLINE 3 -> 1, CEILING HELD AT 1, AND THE CEILING'S OLD BASIS IS SPENT SO RETIRED_BY GOES TO `-'.  The exec244 text's headline of 10 was read before the accumulator landing: at this base 02d2e16c44 the six mult/multu/div/divu/madd/msub rows and their sibling are GONE, because REG_ACCHI0 now has an id of its own, so #282 -- the work item this row named as its retiring condition -- has already done what it could here.  WHAT THIS WAVE MOVED, measured in place: the 2 FPSR-GRANULARITY rows on `c.eq.s' at 0x400148 and `c.lt.s' at 0x40014c, where the reference named REG_FCSR as a destination and the wire named nothing.  It was not a granularity difference at all: the architectural destination of c.cond.fmt is FCC[cc], a field of FCR31, and every cmp helper writes it with SET_FP_COND()/CLEAR_FP_COND() on env->active_fpu.fcr31 from INSIDE the helper, so fpu_fcr31 is never an op's output and the destination reached the wire as nothing.  Stated once for the whole family, in the FOP_CONDS macro after the two operand loads, which is the one place every form passes through; the A/B is on one build and the rows moved exactly with it (BASE 3, preserve-read arm 3, statement arm 1).  THE ONE SURVIVOR, named: `cfc1 r9, f31' at p_fp 0x40013c, reg-dst-value, ref REG_GPR9=0 against trc REG_GPR9=4108.  FIR is a machine-IDENTITY register -- implementation, revision and feature bits -- and the two models describe different machines, so neither value is wrong and there is no datum being dropped.  No work item can retire it: RETIRED_BY is `-' and this is accepted as a property of the reference pair.  NO MARGIN: a headline of 2 is a finding.  43 disagreeing rows total, 42 TRACER-SUPERSET all named, 0 UNACCOUNTED, no axis INERT over 432 facts / 114 subjects.  Prior adjudication superseded in its headline and its RETIRED_BY: the exec244 text (23 -> 10, ceiling 1, #282), whose accumulator half landed.

RESIDUE R1 IS CLOSED, AT SOURCE, AND THE SIXTY ROWS ARE GONE.  exec246 named it as 60 rows of FPSR/float_status on p_wpmem fadd/fmul/fcvt needing a helper-usage table for the whole of target/arm, explicitly refusing to rule it reference-side; 48653af97d built exactly that table (target/arm/tcg/insn-df-helper-usage.tsv, generated by scripts/insn-df-arm-fpst-rows.py) and the fpsr-dst-set axis now reads 0 WP-DEFECT over 3,589 facts.  What is left on that axis is 6 GEM5-LIMIT rows carrying REF-MISC-HAS-NO-GENERIC-ID, which is the reference's own naming and was already covered.  THE THIRTY-SIX THAT SURVIVE ARE RESIDUE R2, UNMOVED AND UNRELABELLED, AND THEY ARE ONE CLASS AT TWO PROGRAM COUNTERS: 0x4000dc `dc cvau, x21' (d50b7b35) and 0x4000e4 `dc civac, x21' (d50b7e35), over six excursions of p_wpcache, three axes each -- 2 x 6 x 3 = 36, with nothing else in the column.  Every row reads ref '0L/1S' of 64 bytes at 0x410540..0x41057f against trc '0L/0S' and an empty address list.  THIS IS THE SAME CLASS THE CORRECT-PATH LEG CARRIES as its nine TRACER-SUBSET rows and it is a REAL LOSS by this project's own spec, ruled so in 14c81f0eca with its basis, its refuted candidate and its named fix path; that commit changes no row here and says so.  NOTE WHAT IS NOT IN THE 36, because it bounds the class: `ic ivau, x21' at 0x4000e0 sits between the two and contributes nothing -- an instruction-cache operation is not a data access and the reference issues none, so the residue is the by-VA DATA cache-maintenance forms alone.  NO CEILING MOVEMENT IS EARNED OR TAKEN: a ceiling counts accepted rows, and 36 rows of stated loss are not accepted.  Prior adjudication, superseded only in its headline and in R1's disposition: the exec246 text (114 -> 96, reg-src-set 12 -> 0 at 4b948766dd and fpsr-dst-set 36 -> 30 + 6 GEM5-LIMIT) and R13_VERDICT.md 5.3

exec244 RE-DERIVATION (2026-09-18, all 20 rows measured fresh at one tip). HEADLINE 257 -> 105 = 20 WP-DEFECT + 85 UNACCOUNTED over 5,553 facts / 109 encodings, 42 excursions, no axis INERT.  CEILING HELD AT 0.  THE TWO CLASSES THE x87 LANDING MINTED ARE RULED HERE ON WRITTEN MERITS, AND BOTH ARE TRACER-RIGHT.  (A) 60 UNACCOUNTED reg-dst-set rows, twelve x87 PCs (0x40101d..0x401045) x 5 excursions, only_trc={REG_SYS}.  regmap/x86_64.tsv maps fpip/fpcs/fpdp/fpds to REG_SYS with its own written reason -- "x87 exception pointer: machine state saved for a handler, not a value the program computes with" -- and every non-control x87 instruction updates the last-instruction and last-data pointers, so the wire is stating a real destination.  The reference CANNOT speak: this leg's own report prints "unmappable-id:REG_SYS 42", i.e. gem5's x86 vocabulary has no index that produces REG_SYS.  Reference gap with a checkable basis in the mapper, the same shape as the REG_PC class, and the rule is derivable and NOT YET WRITTEN.  (B) 15 UNACCOUNTED reg-src-set rows at 0x401025/27/2d x 5, only_trc={REG_FCSR} against ref {REG_FPR0,REG_FPR1}.  Under the composed-register contract settled at 050283a3f1 a folded FIELD publishes its CONTAINER, so reading the rounding-control field of the x87 control word IS a read of REG_FCSR; ledger #277c asks this exact question and answers SOURCE.  Tracer right; the rule is written and not ported to this leg.  (C) THE BRIEF'S ARITHMETIC IS INCOMPLETE AND THE REMAINDER IS NOT SLACK.  60 + 15 = 75, and the headline is 105.  Ten rows at 0x401041 and 0x401043 run the OTHER way: ref={REG_FCSR,REG_FPR0} against trc={REG_FPR0,REG_SYS} -- REG_FCSR is in the reference and NOT on the wire, so two x87 PCs do not publish their status-word write.  That is a LOSS, filed as FINDING 244-D.  (D) 20 WP-DEFECT reg-src-set: 15 on p_wprmw at 0x40104d/0x401062/0x401095 with only_ref={REG_FLAGS}, and 5 on p_wpsse 0x40102b with ref={REG_VEC2} against trc={} -- the x86 sibling of 244-C, a vector source not published at all.  (E) 10 UNACCOUNTED reg-src-set on p_wpchain 0x40102a and p_wpflag 0x401047, only_ref={REG_FLAGS}.  So 75 rows are tracer-right and want rules, and 35 are real losses with two findings against them.  Prior adjudication, unchanged: exec33/flagsleak/EVIDENCE.md -- the leg EXISTS and RUNS; R13_VERDICT.md 5/8.1's "x86_64 has no wrong-path execution reference" is FALSE as written

exec245 RE-MEASUREMENT (2026-09-18, three arms on ONE build: BASE, after the FR=0 preserve-read fix, after the store-conditional source statement).  HEADLINE 32 -> 4, CEILING 10 -> 4, and the row's OLD RETIRED_BY list is spent: #269 and #221 named the FR=0 FP-pair class, and THAT CLASS IS NOT WHAT THE HEADLINE WAS.  MEASURED, NOT ARGUED: at BASE the 26 UNACCOUNTED rows on p_wpfp were all strict TRACER-SUPERSET on 13 pcs, every one trc={REG_FPRn, REG_GPR16} against ref={REG_GPR16} -- the DESTINATION of an FP store named as a SOURCE of it.  CAUSE: TCG cannot write part of a global, so gen_store_fpr32/32h/64 lower a narrow FP write as tcg_gen_deposit_i64(fpu_f64[r], fpu_f64[r], ...), and the merge's read of the destination reached the op walk as an ordinary operand read.  R7.1 rules that shape: a narrow write does not acquire a preserve-read source, and under FR=0 the bits carried across are not even architectural (the odd halves of fpu_f64[] are unused there).  FIXED at the four deposit sites with a new anchored primitive, insn_dataflow_note_preserve_read(): the note arms at the op it was taken against and is spent by the write it describes, so an operand load earlier in the same instruction is untouched.  BOTH ENDS ARE LOAD-BEARING AND THE FIRST CUT WAS WRONG: an unanchored version deleted 32 genuine mipsel operand reads where fd equalled fs (`mov.s $f0,$f0'), and the validator's static_reg_sets check caught it -- recorded here because the comment that shipped with that cut asserted the opposite and was FALSE.  THE SECOND FIX, also measured: 2 reg-src-set WP-DEFECT rows on p_wpll 0x400118, `sc $t2, 400($s0)', ref [REG_GPR10, REG_GPR16] against trc [REG_GPR16] -- the stored DATUM missing from the source set.  CAUSE, visible in the source: gen_st_cond() lays both arms of a branchy lowering into one op stream and the FAILURE arm's gen_store_gpr(0, rt) is emitted BEFORE the success arm's gen_load_gpr(val, rt), so a reader walking in emission order meets the write first and charges the read to the instruction's own result.  Stated before either arm exists.  WHAT SURVIVES, ALL FOUR ROWS ONE CLASS: p_flow 0x400138 `jal', reg-dst-valued, x4 excursions, ref REG_LR=0x400140 against trc REG_LR:w=0 -- the wire NAMES the link register and publishes no value for it.  PRE-EXISTING AT BASE and NOT FIXED; witnessed directly on the wire rather than inferred: cst_decode --format=legacy over the wp trace prints `insn[0] dst[0] REG_LR=0x0:w=0' on four wrong-path occurrences of that instruction and `REG_LR=0x400140:w=4' on the correct-path one, with REG_GPR10 and REG_ZERO publishing w=4 in the same excursions -- so the gap is the WRONG PATH's value capture for BRANCH-written destinations, not the register and not the ISA.  FILED AS 245-B.  AND THE CORRECT-PATH LEG IS NOT A WITNESS EITHER WAY: its reg-dst-value axis compares only where both sides state a value, so a width-0 destination is silently not compared there; the cp leg's silence on this pc is an instrument blind spot, recorded so the zero is not over-quoted.  NO MARGIN: a headline of 5 is a finding.  1,703 facts / 80 encodings / 23 excursions, 0 UNACCOUNTED, no axis INERT, 265 TRACER-SUPERSET each carrying a named rule.  Prior adjudication superseded in headline and RETIRED_BY: the exec244 text (154 -> 70, ceiling 10, #269,#221,#266,#282).

exec245 RE-MEASUREMENT AFTER THE THREE DECLARATION GAPS CLOSED (2026-09-18, one tree state, riscv64 binaries unchanged by the later mipsel commit).
